verdict.rationale: Expensify is a SaaS expense platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never mentions one. The Integration Server API with partner credentials and OAuth2 is only a developer building block. The in-app 'Ask Expensify AI' and Concierge features are first-party assistants, not a server an external agent connects to. The '/agent-device' skill in the App repo is a contributor testing tool, not an MCP endpoint.
